cards.title: Investigate High Null Ratio in users.email
cards.rationale: The column users.email has a high percentage of NULL values (15%), which might indicate data quality issues or an opportunity to enforce NOT NULL if the column is intended to be mandatory.
cards.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE email IS NULL) AS null_values FROM users;

cards.title: Review Potential Unique Violation in contacts.country_code
cards.rationale: [Pre-flight blocked: rule 'pattern_not_unique' is advisory; promoting *_code/*_type to UNIQUE destroys legitimate enum-like values (country codes, status types)] The column contacts.country_code matches a unique column pattern but does not have a unique constraint. Review if this column should enforce uniqueness to maintain data integrity.
preconditions: BLOCKED: rule 'pattern_not_unique' is advisory; promoting *_code/*_type to UNIQUE destroys legitimate enum-like values (country codes, status types)
Original SQL: SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) FROM contacts GROUP BY country_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
